one_liner: Notion offers developer credentials, a documented read/write API, and a hosted MCP server.

auth.notes: Public connections use OAuth 2.0; internal connections use a static API token. Personal access tokens provide another bearer-token path.

access.notes: Free-workspace owners can create connections and copy their API tokens. A public connection can be used without Marketplace listing, but listing requires a security review.

api.notes: The public documentation describes HTTPS requests and creating, updating, and retrieving page content, as well as managing data sources.

mcp.notes: Notion describes its MCP server as hosted and actively maintained.

verdict.rationale: Free-workspace owners can create connections and obtain API tokens, and the public API documentation describes read/write operations. Marketplace review is required for listing a public connection, not for using one.

evidence.quote: Unlike internal connections, which are scoped to a single workspace with a static token, public connections follow the OAuth 2.0 protocol: each user who authorizes the connection receives their own access token, scoped to their workspace.
Internal connections use a static credential called an internal connection API token.

The Notion API accepts bearer tokens in this header. Bearer tokens are provided when you create an internal connection, create a personal access token, or complete the OAuth flow for a public connection.
On Free and Plus plans, only workspace owners can create connections. On Business and Enterprise plans, workspace owners can also let members, or members in certain groups, create them.

Click the ••• next to the internal connection to copy its API token. You'll need this token for any API-based automations or workflows your team creates, or to link your workspace to some partner platforms.
Public connections must undergo a Notion security review before being listed on the Marketplace. You can create and use a public connection without listing it.
Send requests over HTTPS to https://api.notion.com.
Now that you’ve made your first request, explore what else you can build.
Create, update, and retrieve page content
Manage data sources, properties, entries, and schemas.
Notion MCP (https://mcp.notion.com/mcp) is our hosted, actively maintained server. It supports OAuth authorization and MCP tokens, and requires no infrastructure setup.
Notion centralizes notes, docs, wikis, and tasks in a unified workspace, letting teams build custom workflows for collaboration and knowledge management.
On Free and Plus plans, only workspace owners can create connections. On Business and Enterprise plans, workspace owners can also let members, or members in certain groups, create them.

Click the ••• next to the internal connection to copy its API token. You'll need this token for any API-based automations or workflows your team creates, or to link your workspace to some partner platforms.
Public connections must undergo a Notion security review before being listed on the Marketplace. You can create and use a public connection without listing it.

problems: The memo states that the deployment model is cloud, but supplies no quoted evidence establishing that Notion is available only as a hosted service.
name: Notion

verification.note: Quotes show public connections use OAuth 2.0, internal connections use a static API token, and bearer tokens also come from personal access tokens. OAuth is the user-authorization path, so primary oauth2 is supported.
Free-plan workspace owners can create connections and copy API tokens. Marketplace security review applies only to listing; a public connection can be created and used without it.
HTTPS requests to api.notion.com plus create/update/retrieve and data-source management support rest and do not contradict broad breadth. The cited reference is publicly readable.
Notion calls https://mcp.notion.com/mcp its hosted, actively maintained server, supporting official and generally_available.
The confirmed quote is on the Composio Notion toolkit page.
Self-serve free credentials and a documented read/write API support buildable_now with no main blocker; Marketplace review is not required to use a connection.
